title: R2 multipart: create/uploadPart/complete round-trip, abort, min part-size rule
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/ (complete(): Promise<R2Object>; R2Object.httpMetadata and customMetadata are non-optional and come from R2MultipartOptions)
https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/blob/main/src/workerd/api/r2-api.capnp (R2CompleteMultipartUploadResponse = R2PutResponse = R2HeadResponse, so the payload carries httpFields/customFields)
https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/blob/main/src/workerd/api/r2-bucket.c++ (parseObjectMetadata expects HTTP + custom metadata for non-list operations and materializes {} when absent)
examples/standalone-r2/main.js (the same chain proven on the standalone stack e2e)
vrt-provider/tests/r2_multipart.rs (part-order, min-size, signed-uploadId rules, and complete() metadata on all three backends)
